title: Stop duplicating the site title in the home page tab title
description: Home's browser tab, OG card, and Twitter card all read "The Puzzle School · The Puzzle School", because home.md's content title is character-for-character the siteTitle in settings.json and SEO.astro appended the suffix unconditionally. Extracted the composition into a new pure helper, composePageTitle in src/lib/pageTitle.ts, which returns the bare site title when the page title is absent, blank, or equal to it (trimmed, case-insensitive) and otherwise composes "Page · Site"; SEO.astro now calls it, correcting all three tags in one substitution. Deduping in the composition rather than at home's call site is deliberate: both strings are CMS-editable, so the collision can reappear from a content edit with no code review in the loop — and the rule stays a match test, not a home-page exception, so renaming the site brings the suffix back. No visual change; verified from the served HTML (GET / returns one title, /about and /contact keep theirs). Five vitest cases pin the rule. prove-red could NOT bisect this change — pageTitle.ts is both the file carrying the fix and the module under test, so reverting it left the test unable to resolve its import (did-not-build, an unknown rather than a negative). Redness was instead established by a semantic revert (restoring the old ternary inside the helper body): 3 of the 5 went red, including the whitespace-only-title case, and the record is AGENT-ATTESTED via prove-red-attest, not tool-measured. SCOPE VERDICT: this cycle is a bug fix outside the project's deliverable set — it delivered none of the five deliverables and deferred none. All five were already resolved in earlier cycles, every one decided by the user; the single pre-existing deferral (upstream codeyam-cms improvements) is unchanged by this cycle and still owed.
